ImageDescription.value: Photos from a short trip from Kannur to Nilambur 2024. En Ooru is a model tribal heritage village located in the town of Pookode, just a short drive from Wayanad's main town, Kalpetta. It is nestled amidst the lush greenery the district is famous for. The primary purpose of En Ooru is to preserve and showcase the rich cultural heritage of Wayanad's indigenous tribal communities. It serves as a living museum and a sustainable tourism initiative that provides a direct source of income and empowerment for the local tribal population. Here one can see authentic, replica tribal huts (like those of the Kurichya and Kurumba tribes) built using natural materials like bamboo, mud, and grass and witness captivating traditional art forms, including tribal dances and music and get insights into their ancient way of life through displays of traditional tools, weapons, hunting equipment, and household artifacts. One can purchase unique, handmade tribal crafts directly from the artisans and try their hands at traditional tribal archery, a key skill for their hunting heritage. It offers an immersive, educational, and ethical way to understand the deep-rooted tribal culture of Kerala in an accessible location. It provides sustainable livelihood, helps in the direct preservation of their culture, and empowers them by making them the primary stakeholders in the tourism model. En Ooru is a meaningful destination that offers a genuine glimpse into the soul of Wayanad's indigenous culture while supporting the local tribal community.

It serves as a living museum and a sustainable tourism initiative that provides a direct source of income and empowerment for the local tribal population. Here one can see authentic, replica tribal huts (like those of the Kurichya and Kurumba tribes) built using natural materials like bamboo, mud, and grass and witness captivating traditional art forms, including tribal dances and music and get insights into their ancient way of life through displays of traditional tools, weapons, hunting equipment, and household artifacts. One can purchase unique, handmade tribal crafts directly from the artisans and try their hands at traditional tribal archery, a key skill for their hunting heritage. It offers an immersive, educational, and ethical way to understand the deep-rooted tribal culture of Kerala in an accessible location. It provides sustainable livelihood, helps in the direct preservation of their culture, and empowers them by making them the primary stakeholders in the tourism model. En Ooru is a meaningful destination that offers a genuine glimpse into the soul of Wayanad's indigenous culture while supporting the local tribal community.
